common.unexpectedError: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

fields.passwordRules: At least 10 characters. Avoid passwords used on other sites.
fields.name: Your name

login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Welcome back. Your conversations are waiting.
login.locked: Too many attempts. Wait {{minutes}} minutes and try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.leadRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in.
twoFactor.failed: That code did not work. Sign in again to get a new one.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: One inbox for WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. Free during the beta.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.verify: If {{email}} can use this, we sent a link to confirm it. It is valid for 24 hours.
checkInbox.reset: If an account uses {{email}}, we sent a link to choose a new password. It is valid for 1 hour.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter the email you sign in with and we will send you a link.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: After this, every device signed in to your account is signed out.
reset.done: Your new password is ready. Every device was signed out, so sign in again.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.done: You can now connect your channels.

invite.title: Join your team
invite.lead: You were invited to a workspace on Setubandh AI.
invite.otherEmail: Invitations work only for the email they were sent to.
invite.switchAccount: Sign in as the invited email

linkProblem.title: This link does not work
linkProblem.reset: The reset link is missing, used or expired. Ask for a new one.
linkProblem.verify: The link is missing, used or expired. Enter your email and we will send a new one.
linkProblem.invite: The invitation link is missing, used or expired. Ask the person who invited you to send it again.

empty.title: Your inbox starts with a channel
empty.description: Connecting WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger arrives in the next release. Meanwhile, invite the people who will answer customers.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.description: Messages from your connected channels appear here, newest first.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.

routeError.title: This page did not load
routeError.description: Something went wrong while opening it. Try again; your data is safe.

shell.createWorkspaceLead: You will be its Owner. You can invite your team next.
shell.workspaceLimit: You own the maximum of {{max}} workspaces.
shell.createFirstLead: A workspace holds one business: its channels, conversations and team.
shell.noNotificationsLead: New assignments and channel alerts will show up here.
shell.loadFailed: We could not load your workspaces
shell.loadFailedLead: Check your connection and try again.

unverified.title: Confirm your email to connect channels
unverified.description: We sent you a link when you signed up.
unverified.sent: A new link is on its way to {{email}}.

settings.loadFailed: This list did not load. Try again.

workspace.title: Workspace profile
workspace.lead: How your business appears to your team, and the time zone for dates and reports.
workspace.readOnly: Only Owners and Admins can change these settings.
workspace.timezoneHelp: Used for dates, business hours and the numbers on Home.
workspace.agentsSeeAllHelp: Off: Agents see conversations assigned to them and the unassigned queue.
workspace.region: Country {{country}} · Currency {{currency}}. Contact support to change these during the beta.

members.title: Members
members.lead: Everyone who can answer customers in this workspace.
members.inviteLead: They get an email with a link that is valid for 7 days.
members.removeLead: They lose access to this workspace on their next action. Their past replies stay in the history.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.lead: Links not used yet. A new link resets the 7 days.
invitations.resent: A new link is on its way to {{email}}.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.lead: Make another member the Owner. You become an Admin. Each workspace has exactly one Owner.
transfer.confirmLead: You will become an Admin and can no longer transfer ownership or remove Admins from the Owner role.

channels.title: Channels
channels.lead: WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger accounts connected to this workspace.
channels.comingSoon: Channel connection arrives in the next release.
channels.verifyFirst: Confirm your email first: we sent you a link when you signed up.

savedReplies.title: Saved replies
savedReplies.lead: Answers your team sends often, ready to insert with a few keystrokes.
savedReplies.emptyLead: You can create them once the inbox opens. They will be shared with your team or kept to yourself.

twoFactor.title: Two-step sign-in
twoFactor.onLead: Signing in needs your password and a code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.offLead: Add a code from an authenticator app to your password, so a stolen password alone cannot open your account.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or 1Password), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manual: Or enter this key by hand:
twoFactor.codesLead: Save these 10 recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. They are shown only now.
twoFactor.fileHeader: Setubandh AI recovery codes. Each code works once.
